Container.Name: cour
Container.Overview: Pick a season of anime together. cour deals the current broadcast season as a deck -- everyone verdicts each title Keep, Pass, or Unsure at their own pace, locks in, then ranks their keeps; the room's combined standings decide what you watch. Seasonal data comes from AniList with no account or API key needed, rooms are simple shared names with no sign-up, and the deck rotates to the next season automatically one month before it airs. Optional: a TMDB API key adds screenshots to the details drawer, and HTTP Basic Auth gates the whole app if you expose it beyond your LAN.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the cour web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where cour keeps the SQLite database (rooms, verdicts, rankings) and the cached season data. The container runs as uid 1000; if first boot fails with 'unable to open database file', chown this directory to 1000 on the host.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Adds screenshots to each title's details drawer. A TMDB v3 API key or v4 read token both work; everything else runs without it.

Config.Name: Basic Auth Username
Config.Description: Enable HTTP Basic Auth by setting both a username and password. Strongly recommended if cour is reachable beyond your LAN -- rooms are gated only by knowledge of the room name. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Basic Auth Password
Config.Description: HTTP Basic Auth password. Required if the username is set.

Config.Name: Show Sequels
Config.Description: The deck hides sequels by default (the picker exists to find NEW shows). Set true to include them.

Config.Name: Pin Season
Config.Description: Pin the served season (WINTER, SPRING, SUMMER, or FALL) instead of following the broadcast calendar. Pinning disables the automatic season rotation -- leave blank for normal operation.

Config.Name: Pin Year
Config.Description: Year for the pinned season, e.g. 2026. Like Pin Season, setting this disables automatic rotation.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

Config.Name: Allowed Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated extra WebSocket Origins to accept beyond same-origin. Only needed if a reverse proxy serves cour under an origin that differs from the container's Host header, e.g. https://cour.example.com.
